label: Comic Halftone
blurb: Reprints the picture like a comic book: four inks (cyan, magenta, yellow and black) each laid down as a grid of dots at its own angle, so smooth tone turns into Ben-Day halftone, with punchy posterised colour and bold ink lines traced along the edges, for the printed-on-pulp look of Spider-Verse and pop art. Dot size sets how coarse the print is, Punch pushes the colours and flattens them into comic bands, and Ink lines controls the black outlines.
